items.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Dylan later and all that. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: No. I didn’t know the significance until Paul then told me that he had discovered Benny Goodman and who else, Basie.
And Dylan later and all that.

Yeah. Billie Holiday, Springsteen. So many folks. So sort of kicking and screaming he dragged me to Columbia to play for John Hammond. And so I played a few tunes and he said, “gee I really love what you play, I’d love for you to record for Columbia, you can come on in and play whatever you want, use whomever you want.” And at that time I didn’t know how extraordinarily lucky and unusual that was, so I just sort of slipped into recording in 1963, and so because Columbia was a powerful label and it got a lot of…
